text:
Arun: Quick sync — catalog ingest sprint today. Targeting staging push 2024-09-12 17:00 UTC, prod at 19:00 UTC after canary. Models: sable-lite-v2, argo3b-fine, comet-aug1. Need someone to run staging deploy + smoke and post results. Will do alias swap for prod. @Maya @Jess @Sam please chime in.
Maya: I can take staging at 17:00 UTC. I'll run the smoke checklist and post p95/p99 numbers. Sam — can you be on-prod standby for 19:00?
Jess: Happy to review PRs now. Which PRs should I prioritize?
Arun: Thanks — PRs: #3456 (sable-lite manifest), #3459 (argo3b model card), #3460 (registry + alias logic). Jess please review #3456 and #3460 first.
deploy-bot: Created staging slot ingest-292111 for models: sable-lite-v2, argo3b-fine, comet-aug1. Slot owner: @Maya.
Maya: Smoke checklist (I'll run):
1) curl health
2) sample generate (sanity prompt)
3) embedding dims check
4) latency check (p95 < 250ms)
Commands I'll run:
```
curl -sS https://staging.api.redwood/models/sable-lite-v2/health
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/generate -d '{"model":"sable-lite-v2","prompt":"The capital of France is"}'
# embeddings
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/embeddings -d '{"model":"sable-lite-v2","input":"test"}'
```
Maya: I'll post results in thread within 15m of deploy.
Jess: Reviewed #3456 — LGTM. Left a comment on #3460 re: default quant config; fix that and I'll approve.
Liam: Suggestion: roll to prod via 10% canary for 30m, then 50% for 15m, then full. Easier to monitor regressions.
Arun: Plan updated: staging smoke -> canary 10% (19:00-19:30) -> 50% (19:30-19:45) -> full (19:45). If canary fails, rollback alias to pre-ingest snapshot 'pre-292111'.
Sam: I'll be oncall for prod window. Monitoring checklist: error rate, p95 latency, token cost spike, request timeouts. If error rate > 3% or latency > 2x baseline, I'll initiate rollback.
Arun: Rollback steps (short):
1) Stop canary routings: set canary weight 0
2) Alias-swap: set alias 'stable' -> 'pre-292111'
3) Trigger cache flush and warm prefixes
4) Postmortem channel: #incidents if paging happened
I'll paste CLI cmds in case:
```
redwoodctl routing set-weight --alias stable --model sable-lite-v2 --weight 0
redwoodctl alias set --alias stable --snapshot pre-292111
redwoodctl cache flush --model sable-lite-v2
```
Maya: Staging deploy complete — health OK, sample gen good, embedding dim 1536, p95 210ms. No errors. Logs look clean.
Jess: Approved #3460 after quant config tweak. Merging now.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started — 10% traffic to new alias at 19:00 UTC.
Maya: Canary results after 15m: error rate 0.2%, p95 225ms, cost within expected. No quality regressions on eval prompts.
Liam: Thumbs up. Continue to 50%.
deploy-bot: Canary weight increased to 50% at 19:32 UTC.
Sam: Monitoring — all metrics nominal. No page.
Arun: Approved full switch in 10m if metrics stay. Thanks team.
deploy-bot: Alias 'stable' now points to new snapshot at 19:46 UTC. Deployment complete.
Sam: Final check — prod p95 230ms, error rate 0.3%. Closing window; I'll keep an eye for 1 hour.
Arun: Great work. Folks, if you see any regressions, tag me and Sam. I'll open a follow-up ticket for retrospective. :tada:
